method: Compared unique declaration source paths and Git blob IDs/modes between each historical checked tree and observed current default tree, with key heads re-read.
limitations: This covers only the 11 paths directly named by 94 historical declarations; other package sources, manifest and dependency inputs are outside this observation.
No SHA-256 rehash, new Lean run, semantic proof, dependency-object provenance or final gate follows.
The current heads can advance and are not an atomic federation snapshot.
